question.problem:
Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Let the joint CDF of $X$ and $Y$ be $F(x,y),$ where

$$
F(15,6)=0.82\,F(12,6)=0.6\,F(6,6)=0.12,
$$

and the supports of $X$ and $Y$, respectively, are

$$
{S}_{X}=\{3,6,9,12,15\},\,{S}_{Y}=\{2,4,6,8,10\}.
$$

Find $P(6<X\le 12,Y\le 6).$
question.worked_solution:
Note the following:

- For a given joint PMF $f(x,y),$ we can think of each point where $f(x,y)\ne 0$ as a point mass in the plane, where the "probability mass" at each point equals the probability associated with that point.

- The joint CDF $F(x,y)=P(X\le x,Y\le y)$ is the total "probability mass" that lies in the infinite rectangular region that has its top-right corner at $(x,y)$ and whose sides are parallel to the coordinate axis.

Given the supports of $X$ and $Y,$ the joint support $S$ is a subset of

$$
{S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y}=\{3,6,9,12,15\}\times \{2,4,6,8,10\}.
$$

Let's sketch the points in ${S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y},$ which contains the joint support.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14201862/assets/715408bbd41d8551b8eadce9df6259f763ec34a702d48f4d116c4164ae5fda50.png)

Let's sketch the region corresponding to the probability we wish to find.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14201862/assets/2c4dbaa771e897551b72f0c12ad2ba6940dfbef450c89815dc0f8912babd6a05.png)

Geometrically, this region can be obtained by taking all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(12,6)$ (the blue region below) and *subtracting* all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(6,6)$ (the red region below).

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14201862/assets/fb0624aa6e88d4811e77d3c38f24d1d20d201b8e7f6cfb23a3278afef794ab5d.png)

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(6<X\le 12,Y\le 6) & =\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(12,6)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 12,Y\le 6)}}-\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(6,6)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 6,Y\le 6)}} \\  & =F(12,6)-F(6,6) \\  & =0.6-0.12 \\  & =0.48.\end{aligned}
$$
